title: mymind closing
description: A blush band under a huge, hair-thin arc that fades out as it falls away: a small brand mark at its crown, then short centred serif paragraphs in large type that drift gently downward as you scroll past, a tangerine pill in spaced capitals, a row of install tiles and a small grey line with a link.
notes: install tiles are hidden on phones, as in the original
text drift is a CSS view timeline
